data.title: A film of a salt crystal
data.goal: A film of a salt crystal

memoryNodes.cue: A crystal forms as water leaves.
A fruit sample has lost water.

data.situation:
The next demonstration was a recorded film. Sand was insoluble in the water, so the demonstrator used a filter to separate it from the salt solution. The water began to evaporate, and a later close-up showed a crystal. A caption explained that salt can crystallize as suitable conditions develop. Another part of the display compared a concentrated coloured solution with a dilute one. Beside the screen, a dried fruit sample illustrated what it means to dehydrate a material. Jo watched the film twice, keeping the separation process apart from the change in concentration. Jo: Did the filter remove the dissolved salt?
Attendant: In this demonstration it separated the insoluble sand.
Maya: And the water?
Attendant: Watch the next part of the film; it evaporates.

The water began to evaporate, and a later close-up showed a crystal. A caption explained that salt can crystallize as suitable conditions develop. Another part of the display compared a concentrated coloured solution with a dilute one. Beside the screen, a dried fruit sample illustrated what it means to dehydrate a material. Jo watched the film twice, keeping the separation process apart from the change in concentration.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一场演示是录制影片。沙不溶于水，演示者用过滤器将沙与盐溶液分离。水开始蒸发，稍后的特写显示晶体。字幕说明在适合条件下盐能结晶。展台另一部分比较浓有色溶液和稀溶液。屏幕旁的干果样本展示使材料脱水的含义。乔看了两次影片，区分分离过程和浓度变化。

glossary.zh: 在特定液体中不能溶解的
glossary.note: insoluble in water：不溶于水；要说明在哪种溶剂中。
glossary.example: The sand was insoluble in water.

externalEvidence.definition: (of a substance) incapable of being dissolved

glossary.zh: 将固体等与通过的液体或气体分离的过滤器
glossary.note: 名词：a filter。滤纸可以阻挡沙粒，不能滤掉已溶解的盐。

externalEvidence.definition: device that removes something from whatever passes through it

glossary.zh: 从液态变为气态而蒸发
glossary.note: water evaporates：水蒸发。也可用来比喻希望等消失。

glossary.zh: 内部结构有规则排列的晶体
glossary.note: 这里指晶体；a salt crystal，一颗盐晶体。
glossary.example: The film showed a salt crystal.

externalEvidence.definition: a solid formed by the solidification of a chemical and having a highly regular atomic structure

glossary.note: 常见规范拼写为 crystallize，英式也用 crystallise；这里指结晶。
glossary.example: Salt can crystallize as water evaporates.

glossary.note: 形容词：a dilute solution，稀溶液；也可作动词表示稀释。

externalEvidence.definition: reduced in strength or concentration or quality or purity

glossary.note: 这里指除去食品水分；脱水食品并非绝对不含水。
glossary.exampleZh: 这个过程能使水果脱水。

externalEvidence.definition: preserve by removing all water and liquids from
